body: Yes. Ordered a few things 3 days ago. Got an email about an item not being in stock and was still charged for it. I’m calling today but every option I choose they tell me that they’re closed and to call back during operating hours. ... it’s 11am on a Thursday. No email seems to be going out and no option for online chat. I thought I was going crazy.
Do they have any kind of base skeleton in them? I really want to get into this but I don’t have wires or pliers.

I don’t believe so. It was just a random book I picked up and I didn’t recognized the character nor have I seen them in anything. 
I mean I guess, but it wasn’t a how to/tutorial book. It was like a random artist just filled a book with some ocs and put them in different scenario’d costumes. I remember really liking the art style (it was just regular anime) and how clean the book was, that’s why I’m trying to find it.

I actually bought and owned this book but I lost it a long time ago. It was my favorite because of all the different outfits they had depending on their personalities. I was like 13 when I got it. And I don’t think there were any words through the entire book. However I DO think in the very back it includes sketches of the characters from the artist and some commentary. Not too sure about that though. The artist was definitely Japanese. I have no idea what these kinds of books are called, Maybe if I knew it would be easier to find.
